item.title: KaiJay Brown, a transfer from Simeon, keeps poise coming off bench for Lincoln-Way East. ‘Going to pay off.’

item.title: St. Laurence sophomore Logan Brown celebrates older sister Olivia’s birthday with a big win. ‘My whole life.’
item.description: Logan Brown produces nine points, six rebounds and two steals for St. Laurence in 59-55 win over De La Salle.

item.title: Wisconsin, behind veteran guard tandem, upsets short-handed No. 8 Illinois in overtime
item.description: Wisconsin held on for a 92-90 overtime win over No. 8 Illinois on Tuesday at State Farm Center.

item.title: Asking Eric: Am I being paranoid?
item.description: Dear Eric: I have friends who have Alexa in their homes, and I understand that Alexa is a valuable tool when used as indicated. I also understand that it “listens” to any conversation carried on in its presence. This bothers me, because we often have intimate and/or professional conversations.

item.title: Playing with heavily taped thumb, Katie Peetz maintains aggressive mindset for Lockport. ‘Going to still try.’
